bullets: Added a first-tab discount offer that reduces Freebucks prices on a single active session across Desktop and CLI, shown via a new detail chip and copy block in the model selector.
Added support for resuming a conversation on a different inference source in the SDK run function when explicitly authorized, such as switching to a user-selected BYOK connection.
Fixed chat session restarts in the CLI to rotate the chat id so fresh conversations save to separate history directories instead of overwriting the previous one.
Added a Supabase promotional pilot version with a single-arm database-focused format that runs separately from the ongoing A/B test reporting.
Added a first-tab discount offer that reduces Freebucks prices on a single active session across Desktop and CLI, shown via a new detail chip and copy block in the model selector.
Added a sponsored-run capability inspection in the CLI that checks project framework, package manager, git, and containment status before showing ads.
Added a Sponsored v2 capability check that inspects project details and sends capability facts to the ads endpoint before polling for sponsored tasks.
Updated the Freebucks daily reset messaging to show a generic update notice and send a timezone header instead of a hardcoded Pacific-time reset message.
Added Y Combinator matching promotion constants that grant a $1,000 credit after collecting $1,000 in verified company revenue.
